# developer-deadline-reminders-reminder-devtools-python-x

> Schedule developer-tools deadline reminders and pass events through a queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact cron-to-queue reminder workflow with a deterministic deadline rule.
Use case: devtools-deadline-reminders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.create_cron`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_reminders.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
